results.bug: Incorrect metrics recording methods causing misleading performance tracking

matched.title: Unified-storage failures are recorded as legacy-storage metrics

results.judgeReason: Finding #1 matches the known bug's root cause. In dualwriter_mode3.go it shows that a failed Storage.Create (and Update) is recorded with recordLegacyDuration when it should use recordStorageDuration, and it explains the effect: storage errors are attributed to legacy, so the performance and health metrics mislead. Finding #3 points to the same class of mismatch in DeleteCollection, but #1 is the most direct match.
